attributes.cardDescription: A marketplace seller: a person's identity plus a numeric rating. Extends MarketplaceMember and inherits its views.
attributes.readMe:
### A subclass of MarketplaceMember

The reusable part of this card is the schema: person identity plus `rating`. Extending `MarketplaceMember` inherits its isolated, edit and fitted views; a consumer that wants different views overrides the formats like any card override.

### Split from MarketplaceMember on purpose

`rating` has no meaning on a buyer. A consumer narrows a seller link to `linksTo(SellerProfile)` (`Listing.seller`) and every other person link to `linksTo(MarketplaceMember)`. One person can still be linked from both kinds of field on different cards — a `SellerProfile` instance satisfies a `MarketplaceMember`-typed link too, since it is one via inheritance.

### Non-goals

This card does not carry review text, only the aggregate numeric rating (written reviews are a separate concept). It does not distinguish a permanent seller identity from a one-off listing — a person becomes "a seller" simply by being the target of a `seller` link, not by any flag on this card itself.
